label: D2 after choosing a1 and reaching S1, in the last ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, only after the agent chose a1 (in_action==1, 100% of mass), mostly when S1 was reached (common a1->S1, 96% of mass; a1->S2 rare gives weak activations), and only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (98% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80), where the value head is low (<5.2). Never fires at D1/GO, after a2, or earlier in the episode. Magnitude rises toward the episode end (ep_trial>=94: precision 0.58; >=98: 0.69) and is largest on the last trials, i.e. it looks like an end-of-episode / low-remaining-value signal gated on a1->S1. Precision is incomplete (~0.44): many late a1->S1 D2 steps stay silent; adding a1 on the previous two trials or value<5.22 gives only ~+3 F1. All predicate variables are observed at D2 (ep_trial is implicit elapsed time).
